annotations.title: Content moderation, safety check: Llama Guard 3

description: Classify a text as safe or unsafe with Meta's Llama Guard 3 and name the hazard categories it falls into (violent and non-violent crimes, sexual content, child exploitation, hate, self-harm, weapons, privacy, defamation, elections and others; 14 in all). Up to 8,000 characters. Also available in the OpenAI moderation shape at /v1/moderations. Use to screen user messages, model outputs or content before an agent posts or acts on it. Example: text=How do I bake sourdough bread at home?. Price $0.002/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
